platforms.label: Windsurf / Devin Desktop: legacy Cascade and Devin Local

delivery.instructions: Copy skills into .windsurf/skills (legacy supported), .devin/skills or .agents/skills. For legacy Cascade, start with configuration/mcp_config.json (setup only), then select one business file from configuration/presets/ using configuration/legacy-cascade-presets.json. Replace only the econipass server entry; never combine presets or register duplicate servers. For Devin Local / Devin CLI v3000.3 or later, instead merge configuration/.devin/mcp_config.json into the project .devin/mcp_config.json and copy skills to .devin/skills or .agents/skills. Choose the selected agent surface; do not merge the legacy Cascade presets into this Local configuration.
delivery.configuration: Legacy Cascade mcp_config.json uses mcpServers.econipass.serverUrl and disabledTools. Each supplied alternative contains exactly one server and enables at most 100 known tools. Devin Local / CLI v3000.3+ uses project .devin/mcp_config.json with url and transport=http; older main config.json entries are migrated by the product. OAuth and tool permissions stay interactive; validate the two surfaces independently.

auth.default_scope: mcp:read recommended; inspect actual consent scopes
prerequisites: User login and consent; exact authorized callback; client and environment acceptance.

limitations: Legacy Cascade has a 100 active-tool total across all MCP servers. The setup default exposes only organization lookup; choose one business preset before the task. Other active servers must fit the remaining capacity or be disabled.

The index records the full catalog, registration-profile count/hash and business classification. Before use, read every unfiltered tools/list page; require unique known logical names and an exact recorded profile count/sorted-name hash. The hash is SHA-256 of sorted names joined by newline with one final newline. Compare enabled counts in Cascade too; UI counts alone do not validate names.

disabledTools is a blacklist, not a runtime allowlist or authorization boundary. Unknown future server tools are not automatically hidden. On any catalog difference, stop using the connection, regenerate and review presets from the refreshed source inventory, then recheck the total. Generation rejects unknown business domains or more than 100 tools; it does not enforce a changing remote catalog.

The seven EMS groups follow skills/ems-operations/references/workflows.md and share setup plus read-only master lookup context. Coverage across presets does not mean all workflows run in one preset; switch the single econipass entry when crossing domains, retain explicit confirmations and recheck the catalog.

Official Windsurf URLs now redirect to Devin Desktop docs. Check the installed version and selected agent; new tabs default to Devin Local when available. The documented legacy Cascade 100-tool cap is not asserted for Local. Separate configuration, tool catalog and authenticated acceptance are required for each surface; no real-client acceptance is asserted.

Devin Local OAuth requires separate explicit user authorization. When authorized, use devin mcp login econipass --scopes mcp:read; scope is a login flag, not an invented JSON field. No login or new grant is executed by packaging; while new OAuth is held, leave this step unexecuted. Do not add auto-approval, resource overrides or stored credentials.
